steps.label: 3238-own-copy239-explanation-saved-notice-dismiss
command: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#webhwpSavedModal');if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089239'||!m.classList.contains('show')||bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(m)._isTransitioning)throw Error('Stable owned saved notice');const done=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Notice hide timeout')),7000);m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});m.querySelector('.modal-footer [data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();await done;return {dismissed:true,editorModified:document.querySelector('#webhwpFrame').contentWindow.HwpCtrl.IsModified};})()

steps.label: 3242-own-copy239-open-normal-direct-fullapply-confirm
command: (()=>{if(!window.__qaExplain239DirectApplyReviewed||document.querySelector('.modal.show')||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089239')throw Error('Reviewed own239 parent');const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[onclick]')].filter(e=>e.getAttribute('onclick')==='itemApplyAll();');if(bs.length!==2||bs.some(e=>e.matches(':disabled')))throw Error('Expected normal FullApply controls');bs[0].click();return {clicked:true,visibleModals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>e.id)};})()
